config_entries.label: Name
config_entries.description: The name of the effect. Defaults to `Fireworks`.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: The interval with which to progress the effect. Defaults to `32ms`.

config_entries.label: Fade Out Rate
config_entries.description: The rate with which to fade out the LED strip, unitless. Needs to be carefully chosen so that the whole strip doesn't light up forever if the fade out rate is too low or that the firework sparks do not propagate for a long time. Defaults to `120`.

config_entries.label: Spark Probability
config_entries.description: The probability to start a new firework spark at a randomly-chosen LED at any given time step. Defaults to `10%`.

config_entries.label: Use Random Color
config_entries.description: Whether to use random colors for new firework sparks. Defaults to using the currently active light color.
